fusions.name: Glimmer Bolt
fusions.desc: Sends a raw bolt of arcana into the first enemy it meets, dealing 8 damage. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Unshaped Burst
fusions.desc: Releases raw arcana from under your plates, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking each back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Bare Current
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Spent Spark
fusions.desc: When you spend mana, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Your armour is 8% higher at all times. Once every 8 seconds.
